title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
abstract: arXiv:2611.32439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME

translated_title: 看见答案，学会嵌入：从后见之明中学习通用多模态嵌入
translated_abstract: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型将异构的多模态输入映射到一个共享的嵌入空间中，其中成对相似度可支持多种下游任务。近期的推理驱动的UME方法使用中间推理为嵌入生成额外上下文，但通常会在推理阶段引入额外的计算开销。在本文中，我们探索将匹配的候选（即配对的目标）作为一种替代性的上下文来源，研究模型能否在训练时“看见答案”，而在推理时无需它也能“学会嵌入”。然而，直接以这种特权上下文为条件，可能会引入仅凭查询本身无法获得的候选特定信息，或者导致以候选为条件的查询表示向候选嵌入坍缩。为解决这一问题，我们提出了后见之明增强的多模态嵌入（HEME），它从这种候选上下文中学习基于查询的后见之明表示。HEME
tldr: 该论文提出HEME方法，在训练时将匹配的候选目标作为“后见之明”上下文来学习基于查询的表示，使模型在推理时无需额外推理计算即可生成高质量的通用多模态嵌入。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes HEME, which uses the matched candidate as hindsight context during training to learn query-grounded representations, enabling high-quality universal multimodal embeddings at inference without extra reasoning computation.
